content.text:
I'm not deciding anything from this page. It's just a list of names. It never tells me which bank or investment house takes less, or which is safe. I'll ask you, and maybe my own clerk at the bank. I'm fairly sure of that. What settled it was seeing my bank in the list with only "תעריפון מ־01.10.2026" under it, and no amount or comparison next to it.

**What I looked at, in order:**
- **Screen 1:** It's all black with grey writing. The big heading says "מה חברה מציעה לי" and under it "בתי השקעות". Each name has a line of small grey words: "קרנות סל · קרנות מחקות · חשבון ניירות ערך", "קופת גמל להשקעה", "קרן חדשה מקיפה". I couldn't read most of them properly and didn't try. I know some of the names, like אלטשולר שחם, הפניקס, מגדל, הראל, מיטב. Then there's "Interactive Brokers", in English, and I've never heard of it. I nearly left here, because it opened with funds and nothing about deposits.
- **Screen 2:** Insurance companies first: כלל, מנורה מבטחים, and more. Then a heading I understood, "בנקים ובתי השקעות נוספים". My kind of names: לאומי, הפועלים, דיסקונט, מזרחי טפחות, הבינלאומי, מסד, יהב. Next to each one it says "בנק · תעריפון מ־01.10.2026". For מזרחי and ירושלים it says "ללא תאריך פרסום" in orange. That's all it says, with no amount anywhere. There are also two I don't know, "וואן זירו הבנק הדיגיטלי" and "פפר". I'd have to click a little arrow to see more, and the page doesn't say what's behind it.
- **Screens 3 and 4:** Only English names, like BlackRock, iShares, MSCI, Nasdaq and "S&P Dow Jones Indices", each with a small number next to it. Those aren't for me. Further down there's a paragraph, "לא נכלל בכלל…", which I didn't really understand. At the very bottom the writing is tiny.

**Words I didn't understand:** קרנות סל, קרנות מחקות, קרן חדשה מקיפה, קרן חדשה כללית, מרכזית לפיצויים, מטרה אחרת, "השקעה במדד" up in the menu, and S&P, MSCI, Nasdaq. I also don't know what the small numbers next to the English names mean, or why some banks say "ללא תאריך פרסום".

**What I couldn't read:** the grey lines under the company names, the bottom line on the last screen, and the orange words on the black background. The whole page is dark, and that's hard on my eyes.

**Where I got tired or worried:** The first screen felt like it wasn't meant for me. By the end of the second screen I was tired of grey lines, and the English names on the third screen are where I would have closed the page. Something also bothered me: the menu says "מקור", but I don't know who runs this site, and I didn't see anything official on it.
